name: cyberark-privilege-cloud-ispss
label: CyberArk Privilege Cloud (ISPSS)
description: FortiSOAR connector for CyberArk Privilege Cloud, supporting both the Identity Security Platform Shared Services (ISPSS) and Privilege Cloud Standard deployments. Manages privileged accounts, safes, credentials, users, account groups, and session recordings via the CyberArk Privilege Cloud REST API (Gen 2).

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server_url
fields.description: Base URL of your CyberArk tenant. For ISPSS: https://<subdomain>.cyberark.cloud. For Standard: https://<subdomain>.privilegecloud.cyberark.com. The connector auto-detects the platform type from this URL.
fields.tooltip: ISPSS example: https://acme.cyberark.cloud | Standard example: https://acme.privilegecloud.cyberark.com

fields.title: Identity Tenant URL
fields.name: identity_url
fields.description: (ISPSS only, optional) Full Identity tenant URL that serves /oauth2/platformtoken. Set this when the Identity tenant ID differs from the portal subdomain (common on ISPSS). Leave blank to auto-derive https://<subdomain>.id.cyberark.cloud.

fields.title: Privilege Cloud API URL
fields.name: api_url
fields.description: (Optional) Full Privilege Cloud (PVWA) API base URL. Set this only if the API host is not <subdomain>.privilegecloud.cyberark.cloud. Leave blank to auto-derive.

fields.title: Authentication Type
fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Authentication method. For ISPSS tenants (*.cyberark.cloud): use 'CyberArk' for interactive Identity user (username/password via StartAuthentication), or 'ServiceUser' for OAuth2 client_credentials (client_id/client_secret). For Standard tenants: CyberArk, LDAP, or RADIUS.
fields.tooltip: ISPSS: 'CyberArk' (Identity user) or 'ServiceUser' (OAuth2 client_credentials). Standard: 'CyberArk', 'LDAP', or 'RADIUS'.

fields.title: Username / Client ID
fields.name: username
fields.description: For CyberArk/LDAP/RADIUS: your vault username. For ServiceUser (ISPSS): the OAuth2 client_id of the service user.
fields.tooltip: Interactive user: username. Service user: client_id.

fields.title: Password / Client Secret
fields.name: password
fields.description: For CyberArk/LDAP/RADIUS: your vault password. For ServiceUser (ISPSS): the OAuth2 client_secret of the service user.
fields.tooltip: Interactive user: password. Service user: client_secret.

fields.title: Concurrent Session
fields.name: concurrent_session
fields.description: Enable concurrent sessions. When True, multiple connection sessions can be opened simultaneously (up to 300).
fields.tooltip: Set to True to allow concurrent API sessions.

fields.title: Use As Vault
fields.name: vault
fields.description: Enable vault mode for credential retrieval. When enabled, configure the Safe Name below. Credentials are retrieved via the Accounts REST API (GET /PasswordVault/API/Accounts/{AccountId}/Password/Retrieve).
fields.tooltip: Enable vault mode for FortiSOAR credential retrieval integration.

true.title: Vault Safe Name
true.name: vault_safe
true.description: Name of the Safe that stores the credentials for vault retrieval.
true.tooltip: Safe name used for vault credential lookups.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified.
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this is set to True.

operations.description: Retrieves a list of accounts from Privilege Cloud. Supports search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.
operations.title: Get Accounts

parameters.title: Search
parameters.name: search
parameters.description: (Optional) Keywords to search for in accounts, separated by a space.
parameters.tooltip: Keywords to search for in accounts.

parameters.title: Search Type
parameters.name: searchType
parameters.description: (Optional) Whether to match accounts that contain or start with the search value.

parameters.title: Filter
parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: (Optional) Filter expression. Use AND to combine filters.
parameters.placeholder: e.g. safename eq mySafe AND ModificationTime gte 0

parameters.title: Saved Filter
parameters.name: savedfilter
parameters.description: (Optional) Search using a predefined saved filter.

parameters.title: Sort
parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: (Optional) Property to sort by, followed by asc or desc. Max 3 properties, comma-separated.

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: (Optional) Offset of the first account returned. Default: 0.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: (Optional) Maximum number of accounts to return. Default: 50, Max: 1000.
